newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast unleaded gasoline prices drift lower.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast unleaded gasoline prices drift lower.

text.p: U.S. West Coast spot unleaded gasoline and diesel prices eased on Monday in quiet discussion as sellers came off asking prices across the board, traders said.
The weaker prices still were not enough to scare up buyers in late trade. "It's dead. Stick a fork in it," one trader said of the dearth of activity in the cash market.
Sellers were asking 72 cents a gallon for regular unleaded gasoline in Los Angeles and 70 cents a gallon in San Francisco, with few deals heard done.
CARB diesel was talked 82/83 cents a gallon and low sulphur diesel was talked 74/75 cents a gallon in both markets, traders said.
Short-covering that pushed up NYMEX heating oil and gasoline prices in late floor session trade had no impact on valuations in the West Coast markets, traders said.
